newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open slightly higher as gilts rise.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open slightly higher as gilts rise.

text.p: UK shares opened slightly higher on Friday, after the Dow registered strong gains overnight as traders bet today's set of employment data will show continued softness in the U.S. labour market, dealers said.
At 0835 GMT, the FTSE 100 added 6.1 points to 3,985.2.
The Dow, up 12 points when London markets closed, ended with a 36.15 point gain at 6,029.38 amid a firmer bond market.
"Most people are betting on a benign number out of the U.S.," said one dealer. "If we get it, I think we'll see most markets rally. I don't think we've seen the (stock market's) peaks yet."
